parameters.name: InsertWay
parameters.description: The method for uploading prefetch files. Text box and OSS upload methods are supported.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the scheduled prefetch task.

parameters.name: OssUrl
parameters.description:
The OSS file address for the scheduled prefetch. Enter the address of the OSS file.
Note: The OSS file contains the URLs that you want to prefetch.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: UrlList
parameters.description: The list of URLs to prefetch. This parameter is used when you upload prefetch files through the text box method.
